description: Triage a three-way merge conflict: classify each hunk as a safe mechanical resolution or risky from caller-supplied base, ours, and theirs lines. Safe hunks return their resolved lines; risky hunks are never auto-merged.

hunks.description: Conflict hunks to triage; each item carries base, ours, and theirs line lists

base.description: Lines from the common ancestor for this hunk

ours.description: Lines from our side for this hunk

theirs.description: Lines from their side for this hunk

path.description: File path the conflict hunks belong to

name: triage_conflicts
